Paragraph.Text: is a notion of weak 2-category that arises as a category weakly enriched in categories. That is, instead of having hom sets, between any two objects a bicategory has
such that the enriched category laws hold up to invertible 2-cell rather than strictly.

Inline.Text: . We may elide the subscript and simply write this as

Math.src:
cal(K)_⋆^(x, y, z) : cal(K) (x, y) × cal(K) (y, z) ->
  cal(K) (x, z)
cal(K) (w, x) × cal(K) (x, y) × cal(K) (y, z) -> cal(K) (w, z)

Paragraph.Text: that compose the leftmost, respectively rightmost, pair first:

Math.src:
alpha_(f , g , h) : (f ⋆ g) ⋆
  h => f ⋆ (g ⋆ h)
cal(K)_⋆^(x, x, y) ∘ ⟨ 1_x, "id" ⟩ => "id" wide cal(K)_⋆^(x, y, y) ∘ ⟨ "id", 1_y ⟩ => "id"

Paragraph.Text: denote the constant functors at the identity 1-cells. The components at a 1-cell

Math.src:
lambda_f : 1_x ⋆ f => f
  wide rho_f : f ⋆ 1_y => f
